remarks: Amazing location and plenty of lot space, with a view of the river, describes this awesome piece of property. This home has road frontage on two main streets, R.C. Hoag Drive (approximately 500') and Front Avenue (approximately 300') and is comprised of approximately 3.75 developable acres. A very spacious 2 car garage in very good condition, approximately 27'X37', is located on this lot as well as a 4-bedroom home with 2 apartments. There are 2 driveways to access this property, 1 on R.C. Hoag Drive and 1 off of Front Avenue. This property is currently not rented.
